Combine a population with an impact vector

Source: R/inputs.R
cm_model.Rd

Combine a population with an impact vector

Usage

cm_model(
  population,
  impacts = NULL,
  interactions = NULL,
  associations = NULL,
  three_way = NULL,
  missing_associations = c("independent", "unknown"),
  adjusted_associations = c("error", "use_as_marginal")
)

Arguments

population

A cm_population(). For convenience, a cm_diseases() object can be given instead, together with associations, missing_associations and three_way.

impacts

A cm_impacts() object with one value per disease.

interactions

Optional cm_interactions() object.

associations, three_way, missing_associations, adjusted_associations

Used only when population is a cm_diseases() object; see cm_population().

Value

A cm_model object (which is also a cm_population).

Examples

m <- cm_model(
  cm_diseases(c("d1", "d2", "d3"), c(0.10, 0.15, 0.20)),
  cm_impacts(c("d1", "d2", "d3"), c(2.5, 5, 7.5), units = "%"),
  associations = cm_associations(c("d1", "d2"), c("d2", "d3"), c(2, 3))
)
m
#> <cm_model>
#>   Diseases: 3 (d1, d2, d3)
#>   Disease pairs: 3 [independent (default): 1; specified: 2]
#>   Impacts: (unlabelled) [%]
#>   Estimands: crude: 3
